spec.title: SSHadowForge / Operator Overview
spec.description: Is the forge healthy right now? Doors, alerts, the event bus, the gateway, builds and merges on one screen. Row 1 is the summary: every tile green. The rows below say where to look next.

spec.title: Forge doors up
spec.description: Metrics doors answering: gateway, projector, notifier, dispatcher and the workflow's. Fewer than 5 is a service down, or a door refusing Prometheus.

spec.title: NATS doors up
spec.description: The exporter behind each NATS server's metrics door (one per server).

spec.title: Firing alerts
spec.description: Forge and bus alerts. SshadowforgeEventsRefused fires on purpose for a while after every `make verify` (check 45 publishes forged events).

spec.title: Durables stuck
spec.description: SSHadowForge durables holding an unacknowledged message with no progress for 10m. Every one runs MaxAckPending 1, so ONE stuck message blocks every later event for every repository.

spec.expr: count((max by (stream_name, consumer_name) (jetstream_consumer_num_ack_pending{consumer_name=~"sshadowforge-.+"}) > 0) and on (stream_name, consumer_name) (max by (stream_name, consumer_name) (changes(jetstream_consumer_ack_floor_stream_seq{consumer_name=~"sshadowforge-.+"}[10m])) == 0)) or vector(0)

spec.title: Bus backlog
spec.description: The largest backlog of any SSHadowForge durable on SF_WORK_LOG.

spec.title: Gateway 5xx
spec.description: Share of gateway requests answered 5xx. A 503 is often the auth seal failing closed: the gateway could not reach Vault to sign.

spec.title: Commands accepted
spec.description: Issues, pull requests, comments, approvals... admitted by the gateway in the last hour.

spec.expr: sum(((increase(sfd_commands_total{result="accepted"}[1h]) + (min_over_time(sfd_commands_total{result="accepted"}[1h]) unless sfd_commands_total{result="accepted"} offset 1h)) or increase(sfd_commands_total{result="accepted"}[1h]))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Commands refused
spec.description: Refused by the gateway: schema, signature, authorization, enrolment, or an unavailable dependency. The Event Pipeline dashboard says which.

spec.expr: sum(((increase(sfd_commands_total{result!="accepted"}[1h]) + (min_over_time(sfd_commands_total{result!="accepted"}[1h]) unless sfd_commands_total{result!="accepted"} offset 1h)) or increase(sfd_commands_total{result!="accepted"}[1h]))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Events refused
spec.description: Events the CONSUMERS refused (no seal, bad signature, contract). Nothing the gateway admits is refused, so outside a verify run this means something else wrote to the bus.

spec.title: Builds finished
spec.description: Build workflows that reached an outcome.

spec.expr: sum(((increase(sfd_builds_finished_total[1h]) + (min_over_time(sfd_builds_finished_total[1h]) unless sfd_builds_finished_total offset 1h)) or increase(sfd_builds_finished_total[1h]))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Builds not passed
spec.description: build_failed, scan_rejected, scan_error or refused. Builds dashboard.

spec.title: Bus backlog by durable
spec.description: Pending messages per SSHadowForge durable. A backlog that does not drain while ack-pending stays at 1 is the F8 wedge.

spec.title: Commands by result
spec.description: Gateway admissions and each refusal reason.

spec.title: Builds by result (per hour)
spec.description: Rolling one-hour count of finished builds, by result.

spec.expr: sum by (result) (((increase(sfd_builds_finished_total[1h]) + (min_over_time(sfd_builds_finished_total[1h]) unless sfd_builds_finished_total offset 1h)) or increase(sfd_builds_finished_total[1h])))

spec.title: Firing alerts
spec.description: Forge and bus alerts firing now, with their labels.

spec.title: Health -- every tile should be green
